jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about AI/ML, programming, and automation? Do you have technical expertise in design, software development, and modeling? Do you aspire to develop the next generation of AI business applications?

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with our data science and business teams to build state-of-the-art models, and perform exploratory analysis on new and existing data to identify, investigate, and solve challenges. You should be comfortable applying a variety of techniques to find the best results and capable of researching new methods to trial. You will work closely within a small team where collaboration is key to achieving our common goals.

• Collaborate with the business to assess opportunities for AI/data analytics technologies and maximize their value/impact for our clients.
• Support the design of AI/data analytics solution architecture and work with stakeholders to develop implementation roadmaps.
• Support AI/data analytics solution implementation and deployment.
• Develop, maintain, and deploy LLM, machine learning, and natural language processing pipelines and models with high performance, quality, and stability.
• Partner with the business to integrate AI and machine learning solutions across various strategic platforms. Models may span across a variety of domains, including but not limited to: LLM-based agentic AI architectures, natural language processing (e.g., document classification, named entity recognition, topic modeling, advanced and semantic information search, extraction), data analytics (predictive modeling, time-series analytics, pattern recognition, recommendation engines), computer vision (OCR), and voice recognition (speech-to-text).
• Research and build POCs for new and innovative AI solutions and technologies.

En tant que Data Scientist, vous collaborerez avec nos équipes de data science et d'affaires pour construire des modèles de pointe et effectuer des analyses exploratoires sur des données nouvelles et existantes afin d'identifier, d'étudier et de résoudre des défis. Vous devriez être à l'aise d'appliquer une variété de techniques pour trouver les meilleurs résultats et capable de rechercher de nouvelles méthodes à essayer. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration au sein d'une petite équipe où la collaboration est essentielle pour atteindre nos objectifs communs.

• Collaborer avec l'entreprise pour évaluer les possibilités de technologies d'analyse de l'IA et des données et maximiser leur valeur/impact pour nos clients.
• Appuyer la conception de l'architecture des solutions d'analyse de l'IA et des données et travailler avec les parties prenantes à l'élaboration de feuilles de route pour la mise en œuvre.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei interessato a generare nuovi affari? Sei fortemente interessato all'industria finanziaria in particolari investimenti? Sei esperto di tecnologia e dati? Lavori esattamente? Ti stiamo cercando!

Come parte del nostro team RFP, ti aiuterà a rispondere a questionari client dettagliati che mostrano i nostri prodotti, persone e strategie di investimento. Queste risposte sono la chiave per vincere nuove imprese e mantenere forti relazioni con i clienti.

Potrai gestire RFP end-to-end, lavorando con grandi set di dati, automatizzando le attività ripetitive e presentando intuizioni chiaramente. Una mentalità strutturata, analitica e la volontà di imparare sono essenziali. Mentre le competenze tecniche profonde non sono richieste, stare a proprio agio con strumenti di analisi dei dati (vedere “La tua esperienza e competenze”) vi aiuterà a fornire risposte più veloci e più approfondite.

I compiti principali del vostro ruolo sono:
• Coordinare e produrre RFP precisi e tempestivi, RFIs (Richiesta informazioni) e DDQ (Domannari Due Diligence) per i potenziali clienti e clienti esistenti in base alle linee guida interne del marchio/stile e alle normative di conformità.
• Per collaborare a stretto contatto con i gestori di portafoglio, gli specialisti degli investimenti e gli esperti di materia soggettiva per migliorare le risposte RFP, assicurarsi che i messaggi chiave siano compresi e presentare le nostre capacità nel modo più convincente possibile.
• Per garantire che il database RFP sia mantenuto aggiornato e accurato, e la qualità è continuamente migliorata
• Per aiutare il team a identificare e implementare soluzioni digitali
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie daran interessiert, neue Geschäfte zu generieren? Sind Sie stark an der Finanzbranche in bestimmten Investitionen interessiert? Sind Sie technisch und datenversiert? Arbeiten Sie genau? Wir suchen Sie!

Als Teil unseres RFP-Teams helfen Sie bei der Beantwortung detaillierter Kundenfragebögen, die unsere Produkte, Mitarbeiter und Anlagestrategien präsentieren. Diese Antworten sind der Schlüssel, um neue Geschäfte zu gewinnen und starke Kundenbeziehungen aufrechtzuerhalten.

Sie verwalten RFPs Ende-zu-Ende, arbeiten mit großen Datensätzen, automatisieren sich wiederholende Aufgaben und präsentieren Einblicke übersichtlich. Eine strukturierte, analytische Denkweise und Lernbereitschaft sind unerlässlich. Obwohl keine tiefen technischen Fähigkeiten erforderlich sind, können Sie sich mit Datenanalyse-Tools vertraut machen (siehe "Ihre Erfahrung und Fähigkeiten"), um schnellere und aufschlussreichere Antworten zu liefern.

Die Hauptaufgaben Ihrer Rolle sind:
• Koordination und Erstellung genauer, zeitnaher RFPs, RFIs (Requests for Information) und DDQs (Due Diligence Questionnaires) für potenzielle Kunden und bestehende Kunden gemäß internen Marken- / Stilrichtlinien und Compliance-Vorschriften.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Portfoliomanagern, Anlagespezialisten und Fachexperten, um RFP-Antworten zu verbessern, sicherzustellen, dass wichtige Botschaften verstanden werden, und unsere Fähigkeiten so überzeugend wie möglich zu präsentieren.
• Um sicherzustellen, dass die RFP-Datenbank auf dem neuesten Stand und genau ist und die Qualität kontinuierlich verbessert wird
• Unterstützung des Teams bei der Identifizierung und Implementierung digitaler Lösungen
descriptionByLocale.fr:

Dans le cadre de notre équipe de DP, vous aiderez à répondre à des questionnaires clients détaillés qui présentent nos produits, nos gens et nos stratégies d'investissement. Ces réponses sont essentielles pour gagner de nouvelles affaires et maintenir de solides relations avec les clients.

Vous allez gérer les RFP de bout en bout, travailler avec de gros ensembles de données, automatiser les tâches répétitives et présenter clairement les idées. Un état d'esprit structuré et analytique et une volonté d'apprendre sont essentiels. Alors que les compétences techniques profondes ne sont pas nécessaires, être à l'aise avec les outils d'analyse de données (voir -) vous aidera à fournir des réponses plus rapides et plus perspicaces.

Les principales tâches de votre rôle sont les suivantes :
• Coordonner et produire en temps opportun des DP précises, des DDR (demandes d'information) et des DDQ (questionnaires sur la diligence raisonnable) pour les clients potentiels et les clients existants conformément aux lignes directrices internes sur la marque/le style et aux règlements de conformité.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de portefeuille, les spécialistes des placements et les experts en la matière pour améliorer les réponses à la DP, s'assurer que les messages clés sont compris et présenter nos capacités de la manière la plus convaincante possible.
• Veiller à ce que la base de données de la DP soit tenue à jour et exacte, et améliorer continuellement la qualité
• Aider l'équipe à identifier et à mettre en œuvre des solutions numériques

Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have sharp analytical skills and a background in counterparty credit risk in hedge funds?

We’re looking for a Credit Risk Officer like you who can:

• evaluate counterparty credit risk based on an understanding of the hedge fund and family office risk management techniques, trading strategies, and infrastructure, as well as a number of other quantitative and qualitative measures of credit worthiness. This will include client due diligence visits for onsite evaluations.
• hold delegated personal authority (within established risk-based limits) to approve new positions or to make recommendations to higher authority levels within Credit. The candidate will be expected to interact with the business units in relation to transactions to ensure the risk fit UBS's ultimate appetite in the sector.
• evaluate transactional risks associated with OTC derivatives, securities financing, exchange traded derivatives, banking products and structured transactions
• prepare, as well as review and approve, written counterparty annual reviews/transactional credit proposals drawing conclusions relating to credit assessment, risk appetite, exposure drivers and business prospects
• lead trading documentation negotiation including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage and Repo Agreements
• ensure all regulatory requests, audit items and operational risk issues are dealt with in a disciplined, timely and efficient manner
• perform ad hoc credit risk analysis and participate in portfolio reviews to identify risk developments or concentrations

Do you have a passion for safeguarding the environment? Do you want to be part of the bank’s journey to net zero operations? Do you have a keen eye for efficiency to shape a lean approach to our decarbonization program?

You’ll have the opportunity to see beyond your internship. If you’re ready to work where no two days are the same, this internship is for you.

• Supporta il nostro Global Lead for Energy Management per sviluppare un robusto sistema di gestione dell'energia allineato con ISO 50001, creando un consenso con i team regionali.
• Assistere i team del sito e del progetto per creare piani di gestione dell'energia e condurre valutazioni di misurazione e verifica per dimostrare l'efficacia dell'iniziativa.

• Coordinate Energy Management Governance Gruppi di lavoro regionali focalizzati sulla decarbonizzazione e sulla copertura dei dati dei contatori delle operazioni di utilità, attività di progresso in linea con le linee temporali e le pietre miliari concordate.
• Analizzare e calcolare il consumo di utilità per assistere le squadre regionali con previsioni di consumo e acquisti di certificati di energia rinnovabile.

Sarete direttamente coinvolti nelle operazioni di progetto quotidiane, acquisendo l'esposizione specifica aziendale da professionisti con diverse aree di competenza all'interno di Group Real Estate and Supply Chain (GRESC). • Unterstützen Sie unseren Global Lead für Energiemanagement bei der Entwicklung eines robusten Energiemanagementsystems, das auf ISO 50001 ausgerichtet ist, und bauen Sie einen Konsens mit regionalen Teams auf.
• Unterstützung von Standort- und Projektteams bei der Erstellung umfassender Energiemanagementpläne und Durchführung von Mess- und Verifizierungsbewertungen, um die Wirksamkeit der Initiative nachzuweisen.

• Koordinieren Sie die regionalen Arbeitsgruppen für Energiemanagement-Governance, die sich auf die Dekarbonisierung und die Erfassung von Zählerdaten des Versorgungsbetriebs konzentrieren und die Aktivitäten gemäß den vereinbarten Zeitplänen und Meilensteinen vorantreiben.
• Analysieren und berechnen Sie den Stromverbrauch, um regionale Teams bei Verbrauchsprognosen und beim Kauf von Zertifikaten für erneuerbare Energien zu unterstützen.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Marketing Strategist to support the UBS Global Wealth Management (GWM) business across the APAC region. Working as part of the regional Market Coverage team, you will set a clear, data-informed direction for brand and marketing activation across APAC countries and segments, ensure alignment with divisional priorities, and orchestrate partnerships that amplify growth, reputation, and client impact.

Scope & Impact
• Work with the GWM regional marketing heads for Greater China, SEA/Japan and Australia and APAC Head of Marketing to shape the end-to-end Brand & Marketing planning process, integrating funnel goals and in-market priorities to deliver measurable outcomes.
• Partner with IB and AM Marketing coverage and Media and Communications teams to foster stronger cross-divisional coordination and One Bank brand and marketing initiatives
• Provide strategic guidance on value propositions, go-to-market strategies, key growth projects in partnership with the business and ensure narratives remain coherent and client-centric.
• Lead a team specialised in digital client acquisition marketing efforts, collaborating across functions, divisions and external partners to design and execute innovative campaigns that drive awareness, interest and engagement in new and existing audiences
• Work hand in hand with Marketing Excellence Labs (MELs), leveraging their expertise and insight for the benefit of the APAC region to deliver efficient and effective campaigns that grow existing clients and generate leads.
• Act as a senior marketing advisor with an increased focus on Australia as a new and valuable GWM book and where IB is already strong and Japan where the business across the Group is ambitious to grow further.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning
• Help define GWM’s multi-year marketing strategy and annual plan, including objectives by funnel stage and region, target-setting approach, and governance cadence.
• Translate strategic priorities into integrated campaign roadmaps, briefing requirements, and KPIs; ensure consistency between top-funnel brand goals and mid/bottom-funnel performance targets.
• Maintain a live portfolio view of programs, reallocating resources to the highest-impact opportunities amid constrained budgets and competitive noise.

Regional & Cross-Divisional Support
• Provide an objective APAC-wide perspective to avoid fragmented approaches and ensure cohesive regional strategy.
• Support a cross-divisional construct offering strategic advice and partnering with on-the-ground teams to deliver integrated outcomes. Seek out efficiencies by collaborating with IB, AM and P&C divisions to collectively achieve positive business and client outcomes.
• Bring to life regional on-the-ground knowledge of client behaviours and market dynamics for the benefit of all APAC country plans.

Briefing & Creative Excellence
• Co-create creative/media briefs that demand non-traditional ideas capable of breaking through clutter and driving earned amplification; steward agencies / internal teams to that quality bar.
• Ensure briefs specify funnel requirements by market and articulate how partners will support GWM to align targets and evaluation frameworks.

Measurement & Optimization
• Set and socialize measurement frameworks linking funnel progression to accelerate acquisition and business outcomes; run quarterly reviews to optimize mix, creative, and partnerships against target deltas.
• Champion test-and-learn performance marketing (new formats/channels, neuroscience or message testing) to continuously sharpen propositions and creative effectiveness.
